cohort: Primary amnion epithelial cells harvested from healthy term pregnant women.
finding: Medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) mediates its anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting TNFa-induced MMP9 mRNA expression and activity primarily through the glucocorticoid receptor (GR) and partially through progesterone receptor membrane component 1 (PGRMC1) in primary amnion epithelial cells.
